# Fixture provenance

Generated by this repo from this repo's own geometry; not produced by Bambu Studio.

Both fixtures are produced by `makerworld-pipeline/tools/make_bambu_like_fixture.py`
(stdlib only), which is deterministic: identical inputs always produce a
byte-identical (same sha256) `.3mf`. Fixed timestamps, fixed deterministic
UUIDs (`uuid.uuid5` on a constant namespace), and sorted ZIP entries with
fixed per-entry metadata make this possible.

## Source geometry

Both fixtures are built from STL parts already committed under
`builds/watch-winder-capsule/parts/`. No external mesh, download, or asset
enters the repository (Native Asset Policy, `.project-agent.md`).

| STL | sha256 |
|---|---|
| `builds/watch-winder-capsule/parts/finger_tab.stl` | `935246d06d51673424254bd23618634a1b4869df0cefac10ff5958e08b20eec5` |
| `builds/watch-winder-capsule/parts/hinge_fixed.stl` | `3d83d6e99600b9c30eb9fdbb5778115580fa958a63c6bd7683b4b17b9decf84d` |

## Generated fixtures

Regenerate with (repo root, stdlib only, no arguments beyond these):

```
python3 makerworld-pipeline/tools/make_bambu_like_fixture.py \
  --out makerworld-pipeline/tests/fixtures/single-plate.3mf \
  --stl builds/watch-winder-capsule/parts/finger_tab.stl \
  --stl builds/watch-winder-capsule/parts/hinge_fixed.stl \
  --plates 1

python3 makerworld-pipeline/tools/make_bambu_like_fixture.py \
  --out makerworld-pipeline/tests/fixtures/two-plate-ams.3mf \
  --stl builds/watch-winder-capsule/parts/finger_tab.stl \
  --stl builds/watch-winder-capsule/parts/hinge_fixed.stl \
  --plates 2
```

| Fixture | Contents | sha256 |
|---|---|---|
| `single-plate.3mf` | 2 objects, 1 plate | `ca196e8cd9e9e60bce03f3405c8a894b910c8015172dbaa13113ff76f585095b` |
| `two-plate-ams.3mf` | 2 objects, 2 plates, one per plate with a different `extruder` metadata value each (simulates AMS multi-material assignment) | `4bf7e95591bb95a38f385fc480e9ff599c507d5f12c3fdfa05e7127773517677` |

Each `<file>.3mf` has a `<file>.3mf.expected.json` sidecar: per-plate object
ids and the world-space bbox (mm), computed by the generator from the same
vertex data it wrote into the ZIP. `tests/test_fixture_format.py` re-derives
this bbox with its OWN from-scratch reader (parses the ZIP's actual XML,
resolves `<component>`/`<item>` transforms per the 3MF core spec) and checks
it against the sidecar within 0.01mm -- this catches transform-math bugs
that a self-referential check would miss.

## Generator version / observed real-file version

`make_bambu_like_fixture.py` identifies itself honestly in its output
(`<metadata name="Application">makerworld-pipeline fixture-generator 1.0
(not Bambu Studio)</metadata>`) -- it never claims to be Bambu Studio.

The real Bambu Studio 3MF used as the external structural oracle this
session was produced by `BambuStudio-01.07.04.52` (from its own
`3D/3dmodel.model` `<metadata name="Application">`). If a future Bambu
Studio version changes the 3MF layout, the structural diff test
(`StructuralDiffAgainstRealBambuTests`, gated on `BAMBU_REAL_3MF`) will fail
against a newly captured real file and this table/the KNOWN GAPS below will
need updating.

## Known gaps (deliberate, checked by the structural diff test)

The structural diff test asserts these exact gaps against the real file --
an undocumented new gap fails the test loudly. Anything NOT listed here that
the generator emits is asserted to also exist in the real file (the
generator never invents tags/attributes/keys/members).

**ZIP members present in the real file, intentionally not generated:**
- `Metadata/cut_information.xml` -- Bambu's cut-tool bookkeeping; irrelevant
  to unsliced fixtures with no cut operations applied.
- `Metadata/top_1.png`, `Metadata/pick_1.png` -- secondary UI thumbnails;
  only the primary `plate_N.png` thumbnail is generated.

**XML tags present in the real file's `.config`/`.model` files, intentionally
not generated:**
- `<assemble>`, `<assemble_item>` (in `model_settings.config`) -- Bambu's
  assembly-feature world positions. Redundant with the `<build><item>`
  transform this fixture already carries; the validator (P4) does not need
  a second source of per-object world position.

**`<metadata key="...">` names present in the real file's
`model_settings.config`, intentionally not generated:**
- `source_file`, `source_object_id`, `source_volume_id`, `source_offset_x`,
  `source_offset_y`, `source_offset_z` -- Bambu's part edit-history
  bookkeeping; meaningless for STL-imported fixture geometry with no edit
  history to record.
- `top_file`, `pick_file` -- point at the two omitted thumbnail PNGs above.
- `plater_name`, `locked` -- cosmetic UI state, not structural.

## Scope

This fixture proves the PARSER's structural handling (tag shapes, ZIP
layout, transform resolution) against a real file -- it is not a slicer
acceptance test and does not prove Bambu Studio itself would open these
exact bytes without complaint. Real user-supplied `.3mf` files remain the
"bring your own 3MF" path (a later phase in this plan).
